system.description:
Hanami Style: Defensive Cloak · cast at A-Rank · no type

A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 4d6 necrotic damage; you gain temporary hit points equal to the necrotic damage (twice per turn).

Monstrous Burst: it splashes onto all creatures of your choice within 10 feet instead.

Healers Touch: it also triggers when an ally within 10 feet takes damage from a melee attack, affecting the attacker.
